lines.beaver_en: Let me ask first. Isn't success important?
lines.learner: 성공이 다 뭐예요? 자아실현이 더 중요하죠.
lines.en: What do you mean, success? Self-realization matters more.
lines.roman: seonggongi da mwoyeyo? jaasilhyeoni deo jungyohajyo.

lines.en: No, it's about finding your own identity.

lines.beaver_en: But in reality, it's easy to fail.
lines.en: Right. I used to fall down all the time too.

lines.beaver_en: But you still tried again. Why?
lines.en: Because I was determined to rise every time I fell.

lines.beaver: 실패가 오히려 도움이 될 때도 있죠.
lines.beaver_roman: silpaega ohiryeo doumi doel ttaedo itjyo.
lines.en: Yes, life's ups and downs are unpredictable. Others' failures teach us too.

lines.beaver: 가치관과 삶의 의미에 대해 더 말씀해 주시겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Could you say more about values and the meaning of life?
lines.beaver_roman: gachigwangwa salmui uimie daehae deo malsseumhae jusigetseumnikka?
lines.learner: 인간의 존엄성을 지키는 게 가장 큰 덕목이에요.
lines.en: Protecting human dignity is the greatest virtue.
lines.roman: inganui joneomseongeul jikineun ge gajang keun deongmogieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thinkers of the past said something similar.
lines.learner: 네, 의를 따르는 게 사람의 도리라고 했죠.
lines.en: Yes, they said following righteousness is our duty.
lines.roman: ne, uireul ttareuneun ge saramui dorirago haetjyo.

lines.beaver_en: Still, it's hard to make a living on ideals alone.
lines.learner: 힘들다손 치더라도 자아를 잃으면 안 되죠.
lines.en: Even granting it's hard, we shouldn't lose ourselves.
lines.roman: himdeuldason chideorado jaareul ireumyeon an doejyo.

lines.beaver: 임종 때 사람들이 가장 후회하는 게 뭘까요?
lines.beaver_en: What do people regret most at the moment of death?
lines.beaver_roman: imjong ttae saramdeuri gajang huhoehaneun ge mwolkkayo?
lines.en: They say they regret not living true to themselves.

lines.beaver: 좋은 말씀이네요. 오늘 결론은 뭘로 할까요?
lines.beaver_en: Well said. What should our conclusion be today?
lines.beaver_roman: joeun malsseumineyo. oneul gyeolloneun mwollo halkkayo?
lines.learner: 몸은 사라져도 삶의 태도는 남는다, 어때요?
lines.en: The body fades, but one's attitude remains. How's that?
lines.roman: momeun sarajyeodo salmui taedoneun namneunda, eottaeyo?
